sup:70140.text:
Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. Please find our Angebot below. We are very excited about the opportunity to work together with Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH and to prove ourselves as a reliable partner for your business!

For our offer, we can propose a price of €47.00 per unit, alongside a quality commitment of 6400 ppm. 

Please note that this offer stays valid for 30 days. We are eager to show you what we can do and hope this initial quote meets your expectations. Let us know if you have any questions at all.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.

move.subject: Re: Quote from Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.: Kalwisz: bearing brackets in red
move.body:
Dear Sir or Madam,

Thank you for your offer and for the time your team has put into it.
We can confirm that the binding volume below covers our full demand for this part over the term, and we appreciate your enthusiasm about working together. We understand that payment timing matters to you, but the payment terms are fixed for this agreement; our forecast for this part is rising. Could you support the quality level set out in our proposal?

We confirm a binding volume of 15900 units a year for the 12-month term, our full demand for this part, all placed with you.

Electricity producer prices changed -6.1% from 2025-11 to 2026-08 (idx:PPI-D351@2025-11, idx:PPI-D351@2026-08).
Our last 3 orders for this part were at EUR 45.15 (po:4500014429-10, po:4500014373-10, po:4500014306-10).
Our forecast for this part is up 20.0% (fc:310020@2026-09).

On this basis we propose: EUR 41.36 per unit, 300 ppm, chargeback EUR 0 per complaint, for our full demand of 15900 units a year over 12 months.

Kind regards,
Hollerau Pumpenwerke, Purchasing

Hello,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We checked the index change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. Also, we checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We see your figures, but we cannot give up margin right now. Faster payment would help us more than anything. Faster payment is welcome; we can reflect it in the price. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 60 days net. If payment terms are fixed, we really need you to stop paying late, as it causes issues for us. 

We can do the 300 ppm you asked for, but it means extra work for our team. Because of the 15900 units volume you confirmed, I can drop the price to EUR 46.00. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? 

Our current offer is a price of €46.00 per unit, a quality commitment of 300 ppm, a chargeback of €0.00 per complaint. This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Kind regards
Marek Lis
Export Manager, Odlewnia Kalwisz Sp. z o.o.
